Owen thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like rice and milk. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. In fact, the conductor lifted the tempo.
The weather was snowy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the photo club by bike. Owen drinks milk after doing sports. Best of all, our team failed miserably in the second half of the match.
Owen wants to be a cook in the future. The photo club is one of the best places in the city. Owen is going to travel to London in April. What's more, the child draws a picture.
There are always many people at the model workbench. Last Tuesday, Owen and Tom went to the photo club. Tom is interested in reading.
